subject: english
stem: Nora feared deep water at the start of summer. She practiced in shallow water and, by August, swam one length with her coach nearby. Which statement is supported?
options: The pool becomes shallower in August.
She gains confidence and swimming ability.
She will never fear water again.

optionRationales.reason: The coach learns to swim.：題目追蹤 Nora。
The pool becomes shallower in August.：未提環境改變。
She gains confidence and swimming ability.：由 fear 到能游一趟，且有練習過程。
She will never fear water again.：always 強度過度。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「故事開頭與結尾在能力、態度、信念或行動上的對照顯示人物變化」可推出 She gains confidence and swimming ability.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 She gains confidence and swimming ability. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
